stories.title: Florida sees spike in dengue fever cases
stories.summary: Florida is seeing a record number of dengue fever cases this year as the tropical disease thrives in warming climates.

stories.title: I didn't know I was lacking in vitamin D until I collapsed at work
stories.summary: Doctors are finding vitamin D deficiency is increasingly widespread in the UK, especially in young people. But the symptoms are difficult to spot and can be missed.

stories.title: Minnesota: Measles cases spike in Todd County, the state total highest since 1990
stories.summary: In a follow-up on the measles situation in Minnesota, state health officials report that the number of measles cases in Minnesota for 2026 has reached a total of 80 cases ,  the most the state has seen in a single year since 1990.

stories.title: Nearly 2 out of 3 teens and tweens use AI chatbots, new research shows
stories.summary: Most kids say they use chatbots for help with homework and when they're stressed, lonely, or anxious. And how they use chatbots is tied to their mental health.

stories.title: Swiss Suspend Funding to MSF Over Chad Sexual Abuse Scandal
stories.summary: This story was originally published by The New Humanitarian. Switzerland’s federal government is freezing some funding to Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) due to the agency’s handling of a sexual abuse scandal that saw staff victimise refugees in Chad.

stories.title: Yellow fever in Venezuela 2026
stories.summary: According to the Venezuela Ministry of Health, through October 4, 12 confirmed human cases of yellow fever have been recorded in Venezuela so far this year.

stories.title: Abuja Ministerial Meeting Offers Governments a Chance to Recommit to Fighting AMR
stories.summary: Action is lagging far behind the milestone commitments of the 2024 UN High Level Declaration on Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR). But a Ministerial Meeting scheduled for 6-8 December in Abuja offers an opportunity to pick up the baton.

stories.title: Ahead of midterms, Missourians defend transgender healthcare
stories.summary: The campaign to defend access to transgender healthcare for young people in Missouri is taking an unhurried approach to talking with voters about the proposed ban.

stories.title: Ebola outbreak update through October 27
stories.summary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) Minitry of Health reports fifty-two (52) new confirmed cases of Ebola virus disease (EVD) have been reported across four provinces: Ituri (31 cases), North Kivu (16 cases), Tshopo (3 cases), and Haut-Uele (2 cases).

stories.title: Eleven states cut Medicaid coverage for refugees who are pregnant or children
stories.summary: When Congress cut Medicaid benefits for refugees who are in the U.S. legally, most states allowed them to continue for children and pregnant women. Arizona and 10 others did not.

stories.title: Hundreds of GP practices lose online services after collapse of tech firm
stories.summary: It will cause huge disruption in some parts of England and Wales, say GP leaders.

stories.title: New law changes make vape vending machines illegal
stories.summary: New vaping rules are now in force in the UK, but what does this mean.

stories.title: Ohio measles cases near 300
stories.summary: The Ohio Department of Health has reported 296 measles cases across 24 counties so far in 2026.

stories.title: Opinion: STAT+: Is AI more a partner, competitor, or crutch for biomedical scientists?
stories.summary: Biologist Paul Knoepfler asks: Could overdependence on AI make us less capable as researchers?

stories.title: Vulnerable 'at risk' as drug needle site closes
stories.summary: Belfast charity workers warn people who use the "life-saving" service will be left without support.

stories.title: World Must Triple Nature Restoration to Meet 2030 Goal, UN Report Tells Biodiversity Summit
stories.summary: The destruction of farmland, forests, wilderness and waterways is still outpacing restoration efforts worldwide, which lag far behind 2030 goals.

stories.title: Africa’s ‘unprecedented’ Ebola outbreak could reach UK, says top health official
stories.summary: Jean Kaseya, of the Africa CDC, warns of the illness spreading like Covid unless more funding is secured to increase preparedness and possible treatment The “unprecedented” spread of the Ebola outbreak means it could reach the UK and other countries, according to one of Africa’s top health...

stories.title: BREAKING: Global Fund Appoints Mark Dybul as Executive Director Amid Mandate and Funding Challenges
stories.summary: Former Global Fund executive director Mark Dybul returns to the helm in Geneva, facing an unprecedented $5.32 billion funding gap, fraught domestic transitions, and mounting demands to overhaul the global health architecture.

stories.title: Call for New WHO Instrument to Address Climate-Driven Global Health Emergency
stories.summary: A decade after the Paris Agreement took effect, climate-related heat, drought, floods, disease and dirty air are killing millions. The authors of a major annual report want the World Health Organization (WHO) to classify the crisis as a health emergency.

stories.title: DR Congo: WHO urges sustained efforts as Ebola cases top 10,000
stories.summary: As Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) surpass the 10,000 mark, the World Health Organization (WHO) has underlined the need for continued efforts to contain spread of the disease.

stories.title: Gevorg Tamamyan: Paediatric Oncologist, System Builder, Transregional Nominee – And a Test for Geneva’s Entrenched Machinery?
stories.summary: Who will steer the World Health Organization through its next chapter? Explore Health Policy Watch’s daily series examining the platforms, records, and institutional hurdles facing each contender for WHO Director-General, continuing today with Gevorg Tamamyan.

stories.title: NHS Western Isles prescribing weight loss drugs at triple the rate of other health boards
stories.summary: A new report finds "significant variation" between Scotland's health boards prescribing new medicines.

stories.title: Pakistan: Nearly 100 mpox cases in Sindh
stories.summary: Sindh health officials reported two new cases of mpox, bringing the provincial total to 98.

stories.title: Patient living in 'horrific pain' due to UK-wide drugs shortage
stories.summary: Jill Kenning says she has been unable to get a drug she uses to manage her condition.

stories.title: Pennsylvania measles outbreak nears 1400 cases
stories.summary: Today, the Pennsylvania Department of Health (DOH) announced that 1,398 measles cases have been confirmed across 44 counties in Pennsylvania so far in 2026.

stories.title: Senate candidate El-Sayed wants to ‘grill’ RFK Jr., calls him the ‘most incompetent HHS secretary ever’
stories.summary: Abdul El-Sayed has made headlines for his progressive politics and stance on Israel. But some supporters consider his public health background critical.

stories.title: What has actually caused the decline in drug overdose deaths?
stories.summary: After years of steep increases, especially amid the pandemic, U.S. overdose deaths decreased 27% in 2024, and preliminary data from 2025 show another meaningful drop.

stories.title: A 'Green Army' is out to thwart El Niño flooding
stories.summary: In Nairobi, a city prone to floods, workers in the "Green Army" are making preparations to prevent disaster when El Niño arrives.

stories.title: DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak tops 10,000 confirmed cases
stories.summary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) Ministry of Health reports on October 25, 2026, 96 new confirmed cases of Ebola virus disease (EVD) were reported across three provinces: North Kivu (58 cases), Ituri (32 cases), and Tshopo (6 cases).

stories.title: Ebola: 20 contacts released from quarantine in Kenya, amid vaccine ‘hope’ in DR Congo
stories.summary: Twenty people associated with Kenya’s first case of Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease have been reunited with their families after being released from quarantine following completion of a mandatory 21-day monitoring period.
